name: SHOTGUN EXORCIST
detailed_description:
SHOTGUN EXORCIST Invites you into a world of chaos where you fight through 24 non-linear levels across 3 episodes as you hunt down the Son of Satan after he pissed off the wrong guy. Inspired by classics like DOOM, Quake, Wolfenstein 3D, and Hexen, SHOTGUN EXORCIST takes on the classic Retro look by having mostly low-resolution chunky textures and low poly models.

Battle through 3 clear-cut episodes that will take you back to the level design of the mid 90's fps games that defined the genre. Use weapons like a saw-gun, a triple barreled shotgun, a crossbow that shoots explosives, and so much more to destroy everything that tries to stop you from achieving your goal.

short_description: SHOTGUN EXORCIST is a bloody retro fps with an emphasis on exploration and horror. Battle through swarms of demon spawn as you hunt down the son of Satan. Kill the unholy and slaughter the dead.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Danish, Finnish, Japanese
